propositions: A committed uv lock freezes transitive dependencies, causing any future advisory on a pinned version to fail the gating pip-audit job regardless of whether the change under review touches the dependency
The current gating applies unconditionally to all changes, punishing authors unrelated to the vulnerability (six unrelated changes went red simultaneously for click 8.2.1/PYSEC-2026-2132)
The gate must distinguish between Gerrit verify lane (block only if the change touches the dependency map) and scheduled main lane (block releases unconditionally) to route blame appropriately

The remedy for an upstream-capped transitive dependency is override-dependencies with documented justification, not constraint-dependencies (which returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected output, not proof of impossibility)
A mechanism must notice when an override-dependencies entry's REMOVE-WHEN condition is met, using a periodic scheduled check following the precedent of terraform-drift.yml and prompt-eval.yml
